## Summary

Implemented `Recite` in `bottle_song.go` per the spec in `.docs/instructions.md`:

- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** builds the verses from `startBottles` down to `startBottles - takeDown + 1`, each with the four standard lines, joined by empty-string separators (no trailing separator).
- **`plural(n)`** handles the singular/plural distinction — "one green bottle" vs. "no green bottles", applied to both the opening lines and the "There'll be…" line.
- **`title`/`uppercase`** capitalize the number word at the start of a line ("Ten", "One", etc.).

No changes to the test files, no new files. `go test ./...` → `ok bottlesong`.
